reason: Raw git is denied for this subcommand. These run without asking: status, add, log, diff, show, blame, shortlog, describe, rev-parse, rev-list, ls-files, ls-remote, cat-file, merge-base, diff-tree, diff-index, diff-files, version, help, check-ignore. These prompt instead of failing: clone, worktree, stash, branch, tag, fetch, pull, remote, checkout, switch, restore, apply, push, commit, reset, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, clean. Anything in neither list is denied here, so pick the nearest listed verb or ask the owner. Note: plugin git via ctx.subprocess (dsh-worktree, dsh-git-plugin) bypasses this guard — it gates only model bash calls.
